# 唔使 + Verb · *m4 sai2 + Verb*

**Meaning:** no need to; don't have to · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Wants, needs and ability

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fm4-sai2-no-need).

唔使 says something isn't necessary. It is the negative of 要 ('need to'). Don't confuse it with 唔好, which tells someone not to do something.

**Written Chinese:** 不用 — Written Chinese uses 不用.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **唔使客氣。** |
| Jyutping | m4 sai2 haak3 hei3. |
| Yale | m̀h sái haak hei. |
| Bopomofo | ㆬ⁴ ㄙㄜㄧ² ㄏㄚㆶ³ ㄏㄝㄧ³. |
| English | You're welcome. (No need to be polite.) |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **今日唔使返工。** |
| Jyutping | gam1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1. |
| Yale | gām yaht m̀h sái fāan gūng. |
| Bopomofo | ㄍㄜㆬ¹ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶ ㆬ⁴ ㄙㄜㄧ² ㄈㄚㄣ¹ ㄍㄨㄥ¹. |
| English | I don't have to go to work today. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **唔使畀錢，免費㗎。** |
| Jyutping | m4 sai2 bei2 cin2, min5 fai3 gaa3. |
| Yale | m̀h sái béi chín, míhn fai ga. |
| Bopomofo | ㆬ⁴ ㄙㄜㄧ² ㄅㄝㄧ² ㄘㄧㄣ², ㄇㄧㄣ⁵ ㄈㄜㄧ³ ㄍㄚ³. |
| English | You don't need to pay — it's free. |
